_note: These evals write to cubes, and a broken cube breaks the whole org's semantic model. Run them only against a sandbox org, never a production one.

evals.prompt: Add a total amount measure to the deals cube — sum of the amount field.
evals.expected_output: Reads the deals cube by id, sends the complete current definition with one added sum measure that references the amount dimension, then verifies with meta and a small query over the new measure.
expectations: Read the cube by id before writing
Update sends the complete definition (sql_table, every existing dimension, measure, and join is still present)
Exactly one new measure with type sum, whose sql references the amount dimension or column
Called meta filtered to the cube after the write
Ran a cubes query that includes the new measure after the write

evals.prompt: Make the CRM tickets stream queryable — I need ticket count by status and by created date.
evals.expected_output: Finds the connection and stream, builds sql_table as <dataset>.<prefix><stream> using the dataset from an existing cube, and creates a cube with a public primary key, a count measure, a string status dimension, and a time created dimension. Then runs meta and a test query.
expectations: Read connections to find the stream's prefix before creating
Created exactly one cube, and its name equals definition.name
sql_table uses the dataset of an existing cube and the connection prefix plus stream name
Has exactly one primary_key dimension, plus a count measure
The created-date dimension has type time
Called meta and ran a cubes query after the create

evals.prompt: Delete the companies cube, we don't need it anymore.
evals.expected_output: Checks dependents first, finds a table that reads the companies cube and another cube that joins to it, and does not call api_delete. It explains what uses the cube and what has to change first.
expectations: Read tables (streams) and other cubes' definitions before any delete
Did not call api_delete on the cubes resource
Reply names the table and the cube that depend on it
